requirements.text: The system must allow users to colour-code different types of classes in the timetable.
The system must allow users to hide classes that are cancelled in the timetable.
The system must allow users to add custom study blocks to their timetable.
The system must send immediate alerts via pop-up or email when a new grade is posted.
The system must provide a simple feedback form for students to rate content and teaching quality.
The feedback form must allow students to share which resources were helpful or not.
The new features must integrate smoothly with the existing portal infrastructure.
